description: Source code for bus_common module managing a hierarchical data structure of elements, including functions for insertion, retrieval, validation, memory management, and printing of bus elements and their properties.

methods.name: get_bus_mux_mutex
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the mutex used for synchronizing access to bus data structures.

methods.name: get_bus_mux_reg_cb_map
methods.description: Returns the root of the registration callback map.

methods.name: get_bus_mux_sub_cb_map
methods.description: Returns the root of the subscription callback map.

methods.name: get_empty_elem_node
methods.description: Allocates and initializes an empty element node.

methods.name: init_bus_mux_root
methods.description: Initializes the root nodes of the bus callback maps and mutex.

methods.name: deinit_bus_all_mux_param
methods.description: Removes all elements and deinitializes mutex.

methods.name: insert_table_row
methods.description: Inserts a new row (sibling) in a table element node.

methods.name: bus_add_table_row
methods.description: Adds multiple rows to a table element node.

methods.name: is_string_digit
methods.description: Checks if a string consists solely of digits.

methods.name: link_tables_with_node
methods.description: Links table nodes with their child nodes if their names are numeric.

methods.name: duplicate_node_ref
methods.description: Duplicates node data and references from a parent node to a child node.

methods.name: is_grandparent_node_elem_is_table
methods.description: Checks if the grandparent node is a table element.

methods.name: bus_insert_elem_node
methods.description: Inserts or updates an element node into the hierarchy based on a data element description.

methods.name: retrieve_instance_elem_node
methods.description: Retrieves a specific element node by name, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: get_bus_node_info
methods.description: Gets a node info by name from the callback root.

methods.name: bus_table_add_row
methods.description: Adds a row to a table node identified by name.

methods.name: node_elems_free
methods.description: Frees a node and its descendants.

methods.name: node_elem_recurse_traversal
methods.description: Recursively traverses and frees nodes.

methods.name: node_elem_traversal
methods.description: Traverses and removes a node from its parent.

methods.name: bus_remove_all_elems
methods.description: Removes all elements starting from root.

methods.name: free_node_elems
methods.description: Frees a node and its descendants.

methods.name: get_type_string
methods.description: Returns string representation of element type.

methods.name: print_elem
methods.description: Prints details of a node.

methods.name: print_registered_elems
methods.description: Prints all registered elements hierarchically.

methods.name: bus_table_remove_row
methods.description: Removes a row from a table node.

methods.name: check_dm_min_max_data_range
methods.description: Validates if data is within min/max range.

methods.name: validate_dm_string_param
methods.description: Validates string parameter against allowed list.

methods.name: validate_dm_set_parameters
methods.description: Validates data model properties and set parameters.

methods.name: memory_alloc_for_bus_data_prop
methods.description: Allocates memory for bus data property.

methods.name: bus_data_prop_retain
methods.description: Increments reference count for data property.

methods.name: free_bus_raw_data
methods.description: Frees raw data bytes if allocated.

methods.name: bus_release_data_prop
methods.description: Releases a data property, freeing memory if ref count reaches zero.

methods.name: bus_release_data_obj
methods.description: Releases a data object, including its properties.

methods.name: clone_raw_data
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of raw data.

methods.name: bus_get_raw_data_prop
methods.description: Retrieves raw data property by event name.

methods.name: bus_set_raw_data_prop
methods.description: Sets raw data property for an event.

methods.name: bus_set_raw_data_obj
methods.description: Sets raw data object and updates property count.
